decision_logic.why_not_public_data_feasible: No audited public record supplies the minimum joint evidence package. Combining unrelated specimens or figure-level values would violate the same-population and transfer-function gates.
decision_logic.why_not_external_data_blocked: HgCdTe STM/STS, local composition metrology, near-critical growth and magneto-optics, and open HgTe spectroscopy are all technically demonstrated. Identifiable author groups and user-facility capabilities provide a plausible acquisition path, although acceptance and data retention are unconfirmed.
decision_logic.why_partner_data_required: The decisive missing information is specimen-linked raw data and calibration metadata that must be obtained from authors, growers, or a coordinated facility experiment.

minimum_partner_requests: spatially indexed raw HgCdTe STS curves plus topography, setpoints, temperature, modulation, tip state and surface-preparation history
raw or minimally processed Hg Cd Te composition map or spectrum image with pixel coordinates, dwell, detector response, thickness and quantification uncertainty
specimen identifiers linking spectroscopy and composition measurements or a predeclared exchangeability design
near-critical mean composition or signed-gap calibration with uncertainty
measured spatial and energy transfer functions
permission to preserve immutable raw and derived records in the repository
unauthorized_work: two-dimensional or three-dimensional R05 production solver
claiming public-data validation from digitized figures
claim_boundary: Absence of a qualifying public record is not evidence that the physical effect is absent.
Figure digitization cannot manufacture missing transfer functions, covariance, or same-specimen metadata.
Open HgTe transport or THz data do not validate a local random-mass DOS signature.
The R05 threshold bracket remains a method benchmark and is not universal.
No measured random-mass field, correlation length, topology, domain-wall transport, percolation, or mobility edge is claimed.
